heading: Мутаційний верстат
title: Mutation workbench
note: New with the MVP (m8 §4; the sketch pages/mvp-screens frame 6 at 0.75, every length x 1.5): the mutation workbench in the laboratory, opened by Interact at the workbench, over the running round. The mouse is freed while it is open; the player stands at the workbench. Points buy three positive mutations; the points show only here. Esc or Close closes it.

states.label: Можна купити й бракує
states.note: 7 points: Quick feet (4) and Spring legs (3) can be bought, Thick skin (9) cannot. The first card's button has keyboard focus, as when the workbench opens by keyboard or gamepad.

nodes.name: Dim
nodes.note: mouse_filter STOP. Dims the running round behind the workbench.

nodes.name: Bench
nodes.note: The workbench panel, 1260 x 690 (the sketch's 840 x 460 x 1.5), centred; raised on ToyBasePanel.

children.name: Balance
children.note: The player's points: the only place they show (decided 2026-10-20: no points on the HUD). Updates live.

children.name: Points
children.note: The points, a number from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Cards
children.note: The three MVP mutations (m8 §4: run faster, jump higher, more HP), equal widths, 32 px apart (the sketch's 22 x 1.5 = 33, the nearest step). Open: their names, prices, whether one can be bought twice, whether a mutation lasts the match or ends at death, whether the HUD shows the ones you have.

children.name: Fast
children.note: One mutation (content data): its name, what it does, its price in points and the buy button. The card looks the same whether it can be bought or not; only its button changes (Buy: enabled, mutation.* "can buy"; disabled with workbench.short, "not enough"). There is no "already have" state: whether a mutation can be bought twice is open.

children.name: Effect
children.note: Takes the card's free height, so the price and the button sit at the bottom.

children.name: Cost
children.note: The price, tr_n("unit.points", "unit.points", price) with {count} = the price (content data; the prices are placeholders, open).

children.name: Buy
children.note: Spends the price and gives the mutation; disabled when the balance is short.

children.name: Buy
children.note: Not enough points: disabled, with workbench.short, {count} = price - balance.

children.name: Close
children.note: Closes the workbench; Esc (ui_cancel) does the same.
